dashboard.title: Welcome to your Dashboard
dashboard.description: This is home base. Check today's collections, see what orders came in today, and track pending work and this month's sales — all in one glance.

customers.title: Keep customers organised
customers.description: Add a new customer in seconds, save their measurements once, and reuse them for every future order. Each profile also shows order history and any balance owed.

orders.title: Track every order to delivery
orders.description: Create an order and move it through Cutting → Stitching → Ready → Delivered with a single tap from its detail page. You always know exactly where an order stands.

settings.title: Billing, staff & more
settings.description: Generate bills and record payments under Billing & Payments, manage your tailors under Staff Management, and fine-tune your shop profile — all from Settings.
